The '''''Wayfarer''-class medium freighter''', also known as the '''''Wayfarer''-class medium transport''', was a medium [[Transport/Legends|transport]] constructed by [[Kuat Systems Engineering/Legends|Kuat Systems Engineering]], a now-folded subsidiary of [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]].

==Design==
[[File:TheRevenge_2.jpg|thumb|left|180px|The layout of a ''Wayfarer''-class transport]]
The ''Wayfarer''-class was designed with a detachable portside section originally intended for modular reconfiguration, allowing it to load a passenger section, a hangar bay, or cargo module into an armature extending from the starboard section. Production costs forced [[Kuat Systems Engineering/Legends|Kuat Systems Engineering]] to scale back their plans and create only the hangar bay module, which served as cargo space for most owners, who generally did not carry or store [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. A few prototypes and custom builds of other modules existed, but were hard to find, limited primarily to bulk commerce corporate shipping operations centered on well-developed metropolitan [[Planet/Legends|planets]] like [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==History==
[[File:TheSmugglersGambit-AR.png|thumb|left|250px|A smuggler-owned ''Wayfarer''-class transport]]
The versatility offered by the detachable module was initially exciting, until it was revealed that the armature could not accept standard cargo containers. This, combined with a high price tag, ensured the demise of the ''Wayfarer''-class's production. Despite the flaws that kept the Wayfarer from becoming a huge commercial success, the ship's versatility made it a well-rounded vessel. It was popular with smugglers who could dump the cargo pod if they needed to avoid customs inspectors. It was also used by Rebel forces as an assault shuttle.<ref name="GAW" />
